=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py (and .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py twin): line 270, `_SHELL_PUNCTUATION_CHARS = ";&|\n<>()"` | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Backtick command substitution is not treated as a command boundary, so credential flags inside backticks are never recognized.
  WHY: A denied Bash command using backtick command substitution with a credential flag has its credential posted verbatim in the permission-prompt report. This is pre-existing (the constant was `";&|\n<>()"` before this PR and is unchanged), but this PR significantly expands credential masking to wrapper commands and shell `-c` command lines without addressing this parallel form of command nesting. The PR's accepted residual risk ("a secret in a form no rule names") does not clearly cover this case, since `mysql -p` IS a named rule — the backtick tokenization prevents the parser from recognizing it.
- docs/implement-plan/issue-5124-mask-credentials-in-prompt-reports.md: lines 7-14 (Status, Stage, Waiting on, Last note) | severity=low | confidence=[5]

  WHY: No automation reads these log lines (no script under `.claude/scripts/` or `scripts/` parses them), so this halts nothing. But operators following the log are directed to wait on an already-satisfied condition.
